items.title: *** 59th EDPS–DPO network meeting ***
items.description: *** 59th EDPS–DPO network meeting *** Today, Data protection officers from across the EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies met in Amsterdam to discuss and exchange views on current priorities and strengthen cooperation within the network. Kindly hosted by European Medicines Agency, the meeting ended with closing remarks by the EDPS Secretary General Leonardo Cervera-Navas, who also published a blogpost with the main highlights. He underlined that direct, in-person exchanges remain crucial to fostering compliance and promoting stronger data protection across the EU administration. items.title: *** 59th EDPS-DPO meeting ***
items.description: *** 59th EDPS-DPO meeting *** Larger scale, more actors, less visibility: what this means for individuals' rights and for supervision. @ Supervisor Wojciech Wiewiorowski opened the 59th EDPS-DPO meeting, hosted at the premises of European Medicines Agency. He used the Justice and Home Affairs package to illustrate a broader trend: processing by EU institutions and bodies is growing in scale, involving more actors and becoming less visible to the people it concerns. He stressed that two things matter more than ever: rights that individuals can exercise, and supervision strong enough to uphold them. The Supervisor reminded Data Protection Officers that they are the first line ensuring compliance in their institutions, and that their involvement must come early and their independence be respected. He also recalled that the EDPS asked for its power to order compliance to cover the designation, position and independence of the DPO.
